lemmas.name: rev66
lemmas.statement: ∀ (words_str : String) (h : reverseWords_precond words_str), reverseWords_postcond words_str (String.intercalate " " (((words_str.splitOn " ").filter (fun w => w ≠ "")).reverse)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro words_str h
  unfold reverseWords_postcond
  exact ⟨_, rfl, rfl⟩
